description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI specifications from FastAPI routes and dependencies, including functions for processing route parameters, schemas, security definitions, and assembling the OpenAPI document structure.

classes.name: OpenAPI
classes.description: Model representing the OpenAPI schema structure, used for serializing the API documentation.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_openapi( *, title: str, version: str, openapi_version: str = "3.1.0", summary: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, routes: Sequence[BaseRoute], webhooks: Optional[Sequence[BaseRoute]] = None, tags: Optional[list[dict[str, Any]]] = None, servers: Optional[list[dict[str, Union[str, Any]]]] = None, terms_of_service: Optional[str] = None, contact: Optional[dict[str, Union[str, Any]]] = None, license_info: Optional[dict[str, Union[str, Any]]] = None, separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True, external_docs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function to generate the complete OpenAPI specification dictionary from given FastAPI routes and metadata.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],dict[str,Any],dict[str,Any]] get_openapi_path( *, route: routing.APIRoute, operation_ids: set[str], model_name_map: ModelNameMap, field_mapping: dict[ tuple[ModelField, Literal["validation", "serialization"]], dict[str, Any] ], separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True, )
methods.description: Generates the OpenAPI path object for a given route, including parameters, responses, and request body schemas.

methods.name: tuple[dict[str,Any],list[dict[str,Any]]] get_openapi_security_definitions( flat_dependant: Dependant, )
methods.description: Extracts security schemes and scopes from route dependencies for inclusion in OpenAPI components.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] get_openapi_operation_request_body( *, body_field: Optional[ModelField], model_name_map: ModelNameMap, field_mapping: dict[ tuple[ModelField, Literal["validation", "serialization"]], dict[str, Any] ], separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True, )
methods.description: Creates the OpenAPI requestBody schema object from a route's body field.

methods.name: str generate_operation_id( *, route: routing.APIRoute, method: str )
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique operationId for an API route.

methods.name: str generate_operation_summary(*, route: routing.APIRoute, method: str)
methods.description: Creates a human-readable summary for an API operation based on route metadata.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_openapi_operation_metadata( *, route: routing.APIRoute, method: str, operation_ids: set[str] )
methods.description: Collects metadata such as tags, summary, description, and operationId for a route operation.

methods.name: list[ModelField] get_fields_from_routes( routes: Sequence[BaseRoute], )
methods.description: Extracts Pydantic model fields from a list of routes for schema generation and validation.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] _get_openapi_operation_parameters( *, dependant: Dependant, model_name_map: ModelNameMap, field_mapping: dict[ tuple[ModelField, Literal["validation", "serialization"]], dict[str, Any] ], separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True, )
